name: Avenue Supermarts (DMart)
description: India's leading value supermarket chain operating on an everyday low price (EDLP) owner-operator real estate model.

name: Trent Limited
description: Tata Group's high-growth retail powerhouse. Operates Zudio (value fashion), Westside, and Star Bazaar.

name: Titan Company
description: Tata Group luxury and lifestyle leader. Dominates branded jewellery (Tanishq, CaratLane), watches, and eyewear.

name: Reliance Retail Ventures
description: India's largest retail conglomerate by revenue and reach. Spans grocery (Smart Bazaar), consumer electronics, and fashion.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail
description: Leading apparel platform operating Madura Lifestyle brands (Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Peter England) and Pantaloons.

name: Shoppers Stop
description: Pioneer department store chain in India. Retails premium apparel, beauty, home, and luxury fragrances.

name: V-Mart Retail
description: Omnichannel value retailer delivering affordable fashion and FMCG across tier-2, tier-3, and tier-4 Indian towns.

name: Metro Brands
description: One of India's largest specialty footwear and accessories retailers. Sells Metro, Mochi, Walkway, and operates Crocs and Fila.

name: Vedant Fashions (Manyavar)
description: India's market leader in men's Indian wedding and celebration wear. Operates Manyavar, Mohey, and Twamev via asset-light franchises.

name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures (Nykaa)
description: Digitally native beauty, personal care, and fashion omnichannel platform with extensive physical destination stores.

name: Devyani International
description: Largest franchisee for Yum! Brands in India, operating KFC, Pizza Hut, and Costa Coffee restaurant chains.

name: Spencer's Retail
description: RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group multi-format retailer operating food, grocery, and household supermarkets in urban clusters.
